placements.title: Deploying Greenhouse Humidity Telemetry Prioritized by Historical Loss Before First Frost
placements.frame: how should greenhouse humidity sensor deployment sequencing and telemetry intervals be configured to protect vulnerable crops from seasonal frost damage?
placements.why: The dialogue establishes an operational commitment to install humidity monitoring across all four bays ahead of frost, sequence bay two first based on prior winter seedling mortality, and enforce fifteen-minute reporting intervals to capture rapid overnight drops. None of the existing retail, transit, or municipal narratives plausibly hold greenhouse environmental telemetry.
